n-k-k9-01.title: Isihloko sisho okuningi kunocwaningo?
n-k-k9-01.goal: Qhathanisa isihloko sezindaba nezibalo zocwaningo esihlokweni, nquma ukuthi yimaphi amagama esihloko adlula ubufakazi, bese ubhala isihloko esingadluli.
n-k-k9-01.material:
Isiza sezindaba zasendaweni sishicilele lesi sihloko.

[제목] 주민 대다수, 공원 야간 개방에 찬성

[본문] 구청이 지난 3일 공원 이용객 50명에게 설문한 결과, 야간 개방에 찬성한 사람은 28명이었다. 반대는 15명, 모르겠다는 응답은 7명이었다. 설문은 낮 시간에 공원 입구에서만 진행됐다. 구청은 "주민 전체의 의견으로 보기는 어렵다"며 추가 조사를 하겠다고 밝혔다.
n-k-k9-01.thinking.1: Ukuqaphela amagama enani (대다수, 과반) namagama eqembu (주민, 이용객)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.0: Ungafunda isihloko esifushane sezindaba ngesitayela sokubhala (-했다, -밝혔다)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.1: Wazi amagama 찬성/반대, 설문, 응답, 절반
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.prompt: Qhathanisa isihloko nezibalo emzimbeni. Yimaphi amagama esihloko adlula lokho ucwaningo olukubonisayo? Khetha wonke afanele.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi ubani obuziwe, kuphi nini, usebenzisa umbhalo womzimba kuphela.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.1: Guqula u-28 kwangu-50 ube yisabelo, bese ubuza ukuthi lesi sabelo siyahambisana negama lenani lesihloko.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.c: Ukusekelwa yilokho okushiwo ngabantu abangu-28 kuphela, ngakho leli gama lisekelwe yizibalo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.d: Ukuvulwa ebusuku yisihloko somubuzo wocwaningo, ngakho leli gama nalo lisekelwe.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.explain: Izivakashi zepaki kuphela ezidlula emnyango ngesikhathi sasemini ezibuziwe, ngakho '주민' banzi kuno-bufakazi. 28 kwangu-50 ngu-56 phesenti, ngaphezu kwengxenye kuphela, okungesikhona '대다수'. '찬성' no-'야간 개방' kuhambisana nocwaningo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.0: Iqembu liphutha ngempela (isihloko ngokwaso sisho njalo). Hlola nokuthi 대다수 inamandla kangakanani ku-28 kwangu-50.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.1: Igama lamandla liphutha ngempela. Hlola nokuthi ngobani ababuziwe ngempela: izivakashi endaweni eyodwa nesikhathi esisodwa kuphela.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola isihloko ngasinye ngezinto ezimbili: iqembu nenombolo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bala kabusha isabelo senketho esebenzisa iphesenti elihlukile.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kusathi 주민, iqembu ucwaningo olungazange lubaphathe, nakuba 과반 ihambisana nesabelo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.c: U-70 phesenti uxuba abantu abangu-28 abavumayo nabangu-7 abaphendule ngokuthi 'angiqinisekile'; u-56 phesenti kuphela ongasho ukuthi uyavuma.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.d: 28 abavumayo nabangu-15 abaphikisayo akuyona ukuhlukana okulinganayo, futhi 주민 iphinde ibe banzi kakhulu.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.explain: 28 kwangu-50 ngu-56 phesenti, futhi ababuziwe babeyizivakashi zepaki. Isihloko siqamba kokubili iqembu nenombolo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala isihloko SOKUQALA esisodwa (umugqa owodwa wesiKorea) obika lolu cwaningo ngaphandle kokudlula.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngeqembu elabuzwa, bese kuba yinombolo noma isabelo, bese kuba yisenzo 찬성.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.1: Shiya noma yiliphi igama elibanzi noma elinamandla kunalokho ongakubala.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Umfundi angatshela ukuthi ubani ophendule ucwaningo?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Inombolo yesihloko sami ngiyibalile kusukela emzimbeni?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ligama elisho umphumela uzwakale unamandla kuno-56 phesenti kwezivakashi ezingu-50?

n-k-k9-03.title: Ngubani ongajoyina ikhempi yekhodi?
n-k-k9-03.topic: Imingcele emithethweni: 이상, 이하, 초과, 미만 (akha izixazululo eziningi)
n-k-k9-03.goal: Funda isimemezelo esinamagama omngcele, thola ukuthi yimaphi amanani avunyelwe, wakhe amaqembu amaningana anelisa yonke imithetho ngasikhathi sinye, bese ubika elilodwa ngesiKorea.
n-k-k9-03.thinking.0: Ukufunda amagama omngcele (이상, 이하, 초과, 미만) ngokunembile
n-k-k9-03.thinking.1: Ukuthola umphumela ofihliwe (inkokhelo ikhawulela usayizi weqembu)
n-k-k9-03.thinking.2: Ukukhiqiza izixazululo ezivumelekile eziningana nokuhlola ngayinye
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izitatimende ezivunyelwe yisimemezelo? Khetha zonke ezifanele.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba ulayini wezinombolo bese umaka inombolo yomngcele ngayinye njengehlanganisiwe noma ayihlanganisiwe.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi igama lisho 'lihlanganisa le nombolo' noma 'ngaphezu kwale nombolo'.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.b: Hlola ukuthi 미만 yenzani enomboloni uqobo: 'ngaphansi kwa-19' ayihlanganisi u-19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.c: Inkokhelo yeqembu engu-20,000 won ncamashi izolunga.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.c: Hlola ukuthi 초과 yenzani enomboloni uqobo: 'ngaphezu kwa-20,000' ayihlanganisi u-20,000.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.d: Inkokhelo yeqembu engu-30,000 won ncamashi izolunga.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.explain: 이상 ne-이하 kuhlanganisa inombolo uqobo; 초과 ne-미만 akwenzi njalo. Ngakho u-14 ungaphakathi, u-19 ungaphandle, u-20,000 ungaphandle futhi u-30,000 ungaphakathi.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.prompt: Akha amaqembu ahlukile angu-3 afinyelela yonke imithetho. n = inani lamalungu, y = iminyaka yelungu elincane kakhulu, o = iminyaka yelungu elidala kakhulu (iminyaka egcwele).
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bala inkokhelo yamalungu angu-3, 4 no-5 ngaphambi kokukhetha iminyaka.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha iminyaka encane kakhulu kuqala, bese ukhetha eyedlule kakhulu phakathi neminyaka engu-3 futhi engaphansi kuka-19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Wonke umuntu uneminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphezulu.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ilungu elidala kakhulu kumele libe ngaphansi kwa-만 19세, ngakho u-19 awuvunyelwe.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Elidala kakhulu lidala okungenani njengelincane kakhulu.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ilungu elidala kakhulu alikwazi ukuba lincane kunelincane kakhulu.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c6: Inkokhelo yeqembu ingaphezu kuka-20,000 futhi akudluli u-30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c6: Inkokhelo yeqembu (7,000 x amalungu) kumele ibe ngaphezu kuka-20,000 futhi ingadluli u-30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.explain: Umthetho wenkokhelo uvumela amalungu angu-3 kuphela (21,000 won) noma amalungu angu-4 (28,000 won), nakuba umthetho weqembu uthi kufika ku-5. Iminyaka kumele ihlale phakathi kuka-14 no-18 nokwehluka okungadluli u-3.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha IQEMBU LAKHO ELIMUNYE bese ubhala umlayezo omfushane wokubhalisa kumphathi ngesiKorea (inkulumo ehloniphekile): inani lamalungu, iminyaka yelincane kakhulu nelidala kakhulu, nenkokhelo iyonke.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa umugqa owodwa wamaqembu akho: izinombolo ezintathu.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala amalungu, bese iminyaka, bese inkokhelo, uphetha umusho ngamunye ngenhlonipho.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Izinombolo emlayezweni wami zihambisana neqembu elilodwa engalakhile?
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Inkokhelo iyonke ngu-7,000 won izikhathi inani lamalungu?

n-k-k9-04.goal: Funda umusho owodwa njengoba umongo omningi ufika, uqaphele ukuthi incazelo iguquka kanjani phakathi kokudumisa nesaga, bese uphendula inkulumo yesaga ngenhlonipho.
n-k-k9-04.material: NgoMsombuluko ekuseni. Ithimba lakho linomhlangano weviki. Ungena egumbini futhi 팀장님 wakho (umholi wethimba) usho umusho owodwa kuwe. Funda ingxenye ngayinye, ukhethe ukufunda okubonakala kunokwenzeka kakhulu, bese uqhubeka.
n-k-k9-04.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza ukufunda uma amaqiniso amasha efika
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxenye ngayinye ukhethe incazelo enokwenzeka kakhulu yomusho ka-팀장님 ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi yimaphi amaqiniso ngesikhathi nendlela yesikhulumi eyenza amagama abe yiqiniso noma angabi yiqiniso.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngaphandle komongo kokubili ukufunda kungenzeka: '참 ...도' kungabonisa ukumangala kwangempela noma ukukhuluma ngokweqile okunesaga. Amagama odwa awanquli.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ukucela ukuthi ufike kusenesikhathi ngesikhathi esilandelayo
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akukho emushweni ocela ushintsho esikhathini esizayo; isicelo sasizosebenzisa isiphetho esinjenge--아 주세요.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Washo okuphambene neqiniso (kusenesikhathi vs imizuzu engu-40 ngemuva), ngaphandle kokumamatheka: lesi isaga. Umfundi ohumusha amagama kuphela uzophutha ukugxeka.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Umhlangano usuqalile imizuzu engu-40 edlule, ngakho akekho owayengadumisa ngokuqotho lokhu kufika.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Isikhulumi asibuzi lutho; ukubheka iwashi kukhomba ukuphawula.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngalolu lwazi olusha, umusho ka-팀장님 usho ini?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Amaqiniso manje ahambisana namagama, ngakho umusho usho ngokoqobo (mhlawumbe ngobumnene). Umongo ungadala ukuhlekisa futhi uwususe.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ngomhlangano ngo-10:30 uphambi kwesikhathi ngemizuzu engu-50, ngakho akukho ukuphuza okufanele kugxekwe.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Akukho uphawu lalokhu; ikhofi nokumamatheka kukhomba ubungane.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Umusho awuwona umbuzo futhi isaziso asiqanjwanga kuwo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.reflect: Amagama awazange ashintshe; amaqiniso ashintsha. Lapho umusho usho okuthile okungahambisani namaqiniso (lapha, 'early' komuntu ophuzile), ozwayo ukufunda njengokuhlekisa (반어). Amaqiniso amasha angasusa lokho kufunda futhi.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.prompt: Buyela engxenyeni yesibili: umhlangano waqala ngo-9:00 futhi wafika ngo-9:40. Phendula u-팀장님 ngokukhuluma okunenhlonipho, uphendula lokho isitatimende sisho ngempela.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokuqamba lokho okwenze ngokungalungile ngesisho esisodwa esifushane.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe impendulo yami ibonisa ukuthi ngiqonde isitatimende njengokugxeka?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isizathu sami noma isethembiso esinye umlingani angasamukela?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngingakhuluma ngale ndlela ku-팀장님 wami (ngenhlonipho, hhayi ngokuzivikela)?

n-k-k9-02.title: Isixhumanisi esiphendula impikiswano
n-k-k9-02.goal: Thola umugqa onesixhumanisi esikhomba impikiswano ngendlela engalungile, ukhethe isixhumanisi esibuyisa ingqondo, bese ubhala kabusha umugqa.
n-k-k9-02.material: Umfundi wabhala isigaba esifushane ngokusebenza ekhaya kumagazini yesikole. Isixhumanisi esisodwa asihambisani nengqondo.
n-k-k9-02.thinking.0: Ukufunda izixhumanisi njengezimpawu zesiqondiso (ukwengeza, ukuphambana, umphumela)
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa onesixhumanisi sokuqala esiphikisana nesiqondiso sempikiswano.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sho ngamagama akho ukuthi umugqa ngamunye wenza msebenzi muni esigabeni, bese ubheka ukuthi igama lawo lokuqala liwuxhumanisa kanjani nomugqa wangaphambilini.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ngesixhumanisi ngasinye buza ukuthi umugqa uyaqhubeka nesiqondiso somugqa wangaphambilini noma uphendukela ngokuphikisa.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uphendukela kusuka enzuzweni (umugqa 2) uye enkingeni, kodwa isixhumanisi sawo sengeza okuningi kohlobo olufanayo. Kudingeka igama lokuphambana lapho. Imigqa 4 no-5 inikeza umphumela nesiphetho ngokulungile.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.prompt: Yisiphi isixhumanisi okufanele sishintshe igama lokuqala lalowo mugqa?
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sho ngesiNgisi ukuthi umugqa unobudlelwano obuni nowangaphambilini.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zama inketho ngayinye emushweni bese ubona ukuthi imigqa emibili isanengqondo ndawonye.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kungasho ukuthi inkinga ingumphumela wenzuzo, okungenangqondo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.explain: Isigaba sisuka enzuzweni siye ekubi, ngakho isixhumanisi kumele sibonise ukuphambana.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa oyiphutha ngesixhumanisi esifanele (gcina okunye komusho). Bese wengeza umusho OWODWA wakho oqala ngegama lomphumela (isibonelo 그래서 noma 따라서) elandela inkinga.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.0: Shintsha igama lokuqala kuphela lomugqa oyiphutha.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ngomusho omusha, buza: ngenxa yale nkinga, izinkampani zenzani noma zidinga ini?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Isixhumanisi sami esisha sibonisa ukuphendukela kusuka enzuzweni siye enkingeni?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Umusho wami owengeziwe ulandela ngempela enkingeni, hhayi enzuzweni?

n-k-k9-05.title: Ukutshela ugogo ngenkokhelo yebhasi
n-k-k9-05.topic: Izindaba ziye ekukhulumeni kwesiKorea sikagogo (bhala kabusha ngomlaleli)
n-k-k9-05.goal: Bhala kabusha umusho wezindaba ngesiKorea esikhulunywayo esinenhlonipho kugogo oneminyaka engu-68 kuyilapho ugcina lokho okuqinisekile, lokho okuhlelwe kuphela nalokho okusebenza kuye.
n-k-k9-05.material:
Ufunda le ndatshana yezindaba efonini yakho. Ugogo wakho (68) uhlala nawe futhi uhamba ngebhasi nsuku zonke. Akafundi izindaba.

[기사] 시는 다음 달 1일부터 시내버스 기본요금을 1,500원에서 1,700원으로 200원 인상할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 다만 만 65세 이상 어르신의 요금은 현행 1,500원으로 유지된다.
n-k-k9-05.thinking.0: Ukushintsha izinga namagama okukhetha komlaleli omusha
n-k-k9-05.thinking.1: Ukugcina amaqiniso nesimo sawo (okuhlelwe, hhayi okwenziwe) lapho ulandisa futhi
n-k-k9-05.thinking.2: Ukubeka phambili lokho okubalulekile kulo mlaleli
n-k-k9-05.prereq.1: Wazi u-존댓말 ngokumelene nesitayela sokubhala sezindaba
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.prompt: Uzotshela ugogo wakho ngezwi. Yikuphi ukulandisa futhi okuyophambukisa izindaba?
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funda indatshana kanye bese ubhala amaqiniso ayo (nini, kangakanani, ubani okhokha ini, kuqinisekile kangakanani). Bese uphawula iqiniso ngalinye ekulandiseni ngakunye.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funa ukulandisa futhi lapho elinye lamaqiniso akho olishiyile alishodayo noma liphendulwa.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.a: Inkokhelo yebhasi izokhuphuka ngama-200 won inyanga ezayo, kodwa hhayi kwabadala.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kugcina uhlelo, inani nokuhlukile, ngakho kuyethembeka.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.b: Inkokhelo yebhasi izokhuphuka ngama-200 won inyanga ezayo kubo bonke.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.c: Kusuka inyanga ezayo abadala bagcina bekhokha u-1,500 won; abanye bakhokha ama-200 won engeziwe.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kuyethembeka futhi kubeka ingxenye ngabadala kuqala.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.d: Idolobha lithi inkokhelo izokhuphuka ngama-200 won kusukela inyanga ezayo.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kuyethembeka: kugcina ukuthi ubani okushilo nokuthi kusengu hlelo.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.explain: Indatshana isho ukuthi inkokhelo ihlelwe ukukhuphuka inyanga ezayo nokuthi abantu abaneminyaka engu-65 nangaphezulu bagcina inkokhelo endala. Inguqulo ephambukisiwe isho ukuthi ukukhuphuka kusebenza kubo bonke, ngakho ilahla okuhlukile okubalulekile kugogo wakho.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.prompt: Yimuphi umusho wokuvula ohambisana nokukhuluma noGogo wakho?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bheka iziphetho zemisho: yiziphi zedeski lezindaba nezigumbi zomndeni.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi isenzo siligama lansuku zonke noma ligama lephephandaba.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kusalusizo lwesitayela sezindaba futhi kuqinile kakhulu ekukhulumeni komndeni.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.c: Isiphetho esilula esingasemthethweni asiheloniphi ugogo, futhi u--니까 uzwakala ungenamandla okubekezela.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.d: U-'인상되오니 … 바랍니다' ulimi lwebhodi lezaziso, futhi usho ukukhuphuka njengokuqinisiwe kunokubikwa.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.explain: Ukukhuluma komndeni nomdala kunenhlonipho kodwa kuthambile (-요), kusebenzisa amagama ansuku zonke (오르다 kunokuba 인상되다) futhi u--대요 ubika lokho omunye umuntu akushilo.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.prompt: Manje tshela ugogo wakho ngamazwi akho esiKorea: imisho emibili ngokuphezulu, ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho kwe--요, akukho ziphetho zephephandaba. Gcina usuku, inani, ukuthi kuhlelwe kuphela nalokho okusebenza kuye.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.0: Umusho wokuqala: nini, kangakanani, nokuthi kuhlelo. Umusho wesibili: kusho ini kuye.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.1: Shintsha igama ngalinye lephephandaba ngegama ongalisebenzisa etafuleni lokudla kwakusihlwa.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe inguqulo yami isasho ukuthi ukukhuphuka kuhlelwe kuphela?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ugogo wami wayezokwazi ukuthi yena uqobo ukhokha okufanayo?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe amagama ami ngawo engingawasho ekhaya ngempela?
